facts.says: Google Play genre ENTERTAINMENT; title PS4 Second Screen; summary: Use your mobile device to control your PS4™.
shadPS4 is a free and open-source emulator for the PlayStation 4. It supports Windows, Linux and MacOS. As of November 2025, shadPS4 can emulate only certain games to varying degrees of support.

judges.reason: The app is used as a second screen to control a PlayStation 4 console.
The app serves as a remote control and companion tool for the PlayStation 4 system.
